items.quote: Bitte überweise den Gesamtbetrag binnen 7 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto bei der Musterbank AG (siehe unten).
items.computation: The invoice is dated Monday 08.09.2025; this is the anchor (document_date) since the sender is a private company, not a German authority with deemed-delivery rules. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (the invoice date) is not counted, so counting starts 09.09.2025. The period is 7 days: 09.09 (1), 10.09 (2), 11.09 (3), 12.09 (4), 13.09 (5), 14.09 (6), 15.09 (7) = Monday 15.09.2025 (§188 Abs.1 BGB). That day is a regular business day (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so §193 BGB causes no shift. Due date: 15.09.2025.
